description: P0.6 similarity spec vectors. close(name, options) = difflib.get_close_matches(str(name), list(options), n=3, cutoff=0.6): seq1 = candidate, seq2 = query, Ratcliff/Obershelp ratio, keep ratio >= 0.6, at most 3, ties by lexicographically larger string. The E_UNKNOWN_RECIPE fix threshold is separate: exactly 1 suggestion, or SequenceMatcher(None, name, suggestion).ratio() > 0.85 (strict >, query as seq1). Recomputed against the reference tool by tests/test_similarity.py.

ratio.note: asymmetric: Ratcliff/Obershelp ratio depends on argument order, so the fix check's order (query first) matters
EXACTLY 0.85: strict > excludes it -> no fix when there is more than one suggestion
EXACTLY 0.6: the suggestion cutoff includes it
just below 0.85 -> no fix when multiple suggestions

fix_threshold.probe: the E_UNKNOWN_RECIPE is produced by replacing features[0].recipe with `recipe` and calling compile_asset

cases.note: exactly 1 suggestion -> fix regardless of ratio (0.8421.. <= 0.85)
